title: Key Lime Pie
hookLine: United States-inspired key lime pie with 8 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Key Lime Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat the oven to 160C/fan 140C/gas 3. Whizz the biscuits to crumbs in a food processor (or put in a strong plastic bag and bash with a rolling pin). Mix with the melted butter and press into the base and up the sides of a 22cm loose-based tart tin. Bake in the oven for 10 minutes. Remove and cool. Incorporate {m52859_1}, {m52859_2}, {m52859_3}, and {m52859_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure digestive biscuits first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Key Lime Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: Put the egg yolks in a large bowl and whisk for a minute with electric beaters. Add the condensed milk and whisk for 3 minutes then add the zest and juice and whisk again for 3 minutes. Pour the filling into the cooled base then put back in the oven for 15 minutes. Cool then chill for at least 3 hours or overnight if you like. Incorporate {m52859_5}, {m52859_6}, {m52859_7}, and {m52859_8} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Key Lime Pie
steps.instructionTemplate: When you are ready to serve, carefully remove the pie from the tin and put on a serving plate. To decorate, softly whip together the cream and icing sugar. Dollop or pipe the cream onto the top of the pie and finish with extra lime zest.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Key Lime Pie to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 6 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
